name: image-viewer
$comment: Licensing-sensitive choices are annotated on the dependency they affect. See docs/LICENCIAS.md before changing any of them.

dependencies.name: libheif
dependencies.$comment: DO NOT remove default-features:false. libheif's default feature 'hevc' pulls in x265, which is GPL-2.0-or-later and would put a GPL encoder in the shipped folder. Without it HEIC is still DECODED (libde265, LGPL-3.0) and AVIF works through aom (BSD-2-Clause). The program does not write HEIC, so no encoder is needed.

dependencies.name: exiv2
dependencies.$comment: GPL-2.0-or-later: the one dependency that blocks closed-source distribution. Used only by src/core/MetadataReader.cpp and src/core/ImageWriter.cpp. Decision pending, see docs/LICENCIAS.md. 'png' (zlib) and 'xmp' (expat) are OFF in the port by default: without them exiv2 does not recognise a PNG at all and cannot read or write XMP, so the metadata a save is supposed to keep was silently dropped (tests/test_image_writer.cpp checks both). 'bmff' (HEIC/AVIF/CR3 metadata, needs brotli) is deliberately left off.
